surface_mechanism_description: The Sr@Ta(OC2H5)5(OC2H4OCH3)2 and Bi(C6H5)3 chemisorbed chemical reactions with the O2 plasma on the surface.
evidence: SrTa2O6 films must be formed by Sr@Ta(OC2H5)5(OC2H4OCH3)2 chemisorbed chemical reactions with the O2 plasma on the surface, it became important to determine the optimal deposition temperature range for the SrTa2O6-ALD process.
